title: Inside Art of Play, the Brooklyn Toy Store at the Center of the Kelly Clarkson Online Frenzy
summary: Art of Play, a high-end novelty store in Brooklyn Heights, has become embroiled in an extremely online feud with the singer and TV personality Kelly Clarkson.
